answer: A workable defense is requiring every agent to lock a refundable bond before it may trade. The registry grades identities the way a prism splits light, so each tier carries different spending limits. An attacker must spread capital across many bonds, and any account caught draining value from the harbor of shared escrow is slashed, keeping the terrace of high-tier privileges expensive to fake. Flooding the network with thousands of cheap identities costs far more stake than one honest agent ever earns.
